title: Power IDEA rule front-matter (claude/rules/*.md)
description: YAML front-matter between --- lines at the top of a rule file; the Markdown after it is the rule text.

applies_to.description: "all", or a mapping; a project matches when any listed criterion matches.

languages.description: rust, typescript, javascript, python, ruby, go, …

paths.description: Globs over project-relative paths, e.g. src/**/*.rs

projects.description: Project roots or globs; ~/ is expanded.
